text_block_list.text:
The year turned—and Hishi Miracle entered 
the Senior Class.

We promised to go for Hatsumode together 
today. Before heading out to meet up, I 
happened to turn on the TV...

text_block_list.name: Show Host
text_block_list.text: It's the UMA-TV New Year Special~!

text_block_list.name: Show Host
text_block_list.text:
First, let's highlight the most-watched 
contenders this year! Leading the pack 
with the highest expectations is none 
other than this Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Show Host
text_block_list.text: It's Symboli Kris S!

text_block_list.name: Show Host
text_block_list.text:
Despite being in her Classic Year, she 
conquered the Tenno Sho (Autumn) last 
year!

text_block_list.name: Show Host
text_block_list.text:
Her ability goes without saying, but her 
stoic nature and appearance are what truly 
capture the hearts of her fans.

text_block_list.name: Show Host
text_block_list.text:
As she grows even stronger this year, she 
will undoubtedly become the center of the 
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: A message—for the viewers?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: No cross, no crown. —That is all.

She was covered differently from other 
Umamusume. A brilliant feat achieved, and 
a noble resolve...

Hishi Miracle was on screen a bit as well, 
but there was a huge disparity in how they 
were treated. And then—
(Prrrr, prrrr...)

A message arrived from Hishi Miracle. Did 
she see that TV broadcast just now and get 
shocked by it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, I overslept! [sweat][sweat] But 
I'm awake now, so no worries (^^)v"

...That message was awfully 
middle-aged-man-ish. Still, she seemed to 
be in high spirits.

After changing, we decided to head out for 
Hatsumode.

If Hishi Miracle didn't see that show, 
that's for the best. She won't have to 
feel down about the difference in how 
they're treated...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-saaan...

"...Her expression was deeply sullen. 
Could this be...?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I saw it~. A friend told me, 'Mira-ko was 
introduced on it too,' so I checked it out 
on UmaTube later."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I was kind of getting my hopes up, 
thinking they might give it a big feature.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still, it was mostly Kris S-chan, and I 
was basically just stuck in the 
picture-in-picture window...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Look at that difference in treatment~... 
And here I worked pretty hard, too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, I know that already. That our 
running is on different levels...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“Aww, hearing it put so bluntly really 
hurts, you know~?”

She knew it already, but hearing it still 
hurt. Hishi Miracle was, through and 
through, an ordinary girl.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Dear gods, I beg of you. Please grant me 
energy."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Like... I just want to at least make up 
for what I lost, you know?

—The energy I lost... I think I can manage 
to recover that much on my own without 
clinging to God.
choice_data_list:
Alright, then how about we do something to 
cheer you up?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you're going to think of something 
for us, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness! Then I'll leave it to you.

The first treat of the New Year. What 
should I have Hishi Miracle do to cheer 
her up?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A noble tea party... That doesn't really 
feel like something for someone like me, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Someone who might throw something like 
that... Ah, maybe one person. That girl 
from my class..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Here you go, Mirako-san! It's special 
Irish milk tea♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Straight tea is nice and all, but loaded 
with milk is definitely the best! Here, go 
right ahead.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~ this teacup... It's so gorgeous~. 
Well then...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Mm... Mmh...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: How is it? Does it suit your taste?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Th-This is...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"What kind of vibe?! I don't get it at 
all?! Like, kind of sleek, and sharp, 
and...?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's suuuper tasty! That much I 
get! Feels like I've become a slightly 
high-class Umamusume or something.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wah, I'm glad you liked it! Drink plenty 
of it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Hishi Miracle spent a peaceful, 
relaxing moment.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Soccer viewing! That's right, high school 
soccer tournaments are on around New 
Year's, aren't they~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
We should definitely go watch. Everyone in 
our family absolutely loves soccer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And after finishing watching the race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"H-Huh? Is that Umamusume over there... 
perhaps...?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Mirako-chan!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Top Road-chan...! Are you here to watch 
soccer too, Top Road-chan?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Both watching and doing it are 
hobbies of mine. Watching others give 
their all helps me stay focused.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Would you care to chat about it if you'd 
like? That match just now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the three of them went to a family 
restaurant.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That was pretty amazing, wasn't it～? She 
kept pushing even after completely running 
out of steam in the second half...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes, no matter how tired she got, she just 
kept putting the pressure on...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Mirako-chan, you really like 
soccer a lot, don't you? If you'd like, 
let's do more!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm really happy I got to talk with 
you too, Top Road-chan~

An endless soccer discussion. The two 
talked endlessly about all sorts of soccer 
topics.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
DIY carpentry... I haven't really done 
much of it before. But it sounds kind of 
fun.

—And so, we headed to a certain place. The 
one doing DIY carpentry there was...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the hand, Akebono, sorry to 
trouble you. Could you bring that wooden 
crate over here?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, this is pretty heavy. I wonder if I 
can make some buono furniture out of it~?

Miho's dorm leader, Hishi Amazon, and the 
big Umamusume, Hishi Akebono, were 
diligently hard at work.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um, would it be okay if I joined in, too? 
I'm a total beginner, though.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, if you wanna try, be my guest. Make 
whatever you like!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Amazon, Akebono, and Miracle! All three 
Hishis gathered, clink-clank-hammering 
away--!!

And so, following the instructions given 
to her, Hishi Miracle tried her hand at 
DIY carpentry...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, looks like I actually made something 
like a bookshelf! It's a little uneven, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
This is super fun~ I wanna make something 
even bigger next time~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, you got it! Next time, let's all 
work together and build a shed or 
something!

Through a day of DIY with all three Hishis 
gathered together, Hishi Miracle learned 
various techniques.
